title: Adelaide CBD tourist precinct trading hours (SA)
summary: The Statutes Amendment (Shop Trading and Holidays) Act 2012 extended shop trading hours in the city by declaring the Adelaide CBD a tourist precinct and created part-day public holidays on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.

instruments.title: Statutes Amendment (Shop Trading and Holidays) Act 2012
instruments.provisions: Amends Shop Trading Hours Act 1977, Holidays Act 1910, Acts Interpretation Act 1915

direction_rationale: Extended CBD hours increase CBD retailers' ability to compete, but the extension is confined to one precinct, potentially shifting share from suburban shops; part-day holidays add penalty-rate costs.

assessment.summary: Extended shop trading hours in the Adelaide CBD only, as a tourist precinct. The gain is confined to one area and may shift sales from suburban shops. The Productivity Commission has recommended removing trading hours restrictions altogether.

marks.reason: Longer permitted hours let retailers compete on convenience and give shoppers more choice.
